positioning.basis: absent from the JPX register, so no disclosed position at or above the 0.5% threshold. A real zero, not missing data -- but the threshold truncates, so 0.4% and 0.0% are both recorded here as 0.0.
positioning.margin_ratio_basis: 信用倍率, margin long balance / margin short balance, scraped from a broker portal rather than published by the exchange. Null is a normal outcome.

expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of twelve ESTIMATED prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. evidence.text: Heiwado will miss its own H1 OP plan by about 10–15% (≈¥6,150m against ¥6,900m) and will report Q2 (Jun–Aug) OP down YoY. Hitting the plan needed Q2 OP of ¥4,329m, +11% on last year's ¥3,889m. Instead, standalone existing-store sales slowed from 102.4 in Q1 to about 101.7 (Jun 103.0 / Jul 100.4 / Aug 101.6, July the weakest in 13 months), all-store from 104.1 to 103.2, after a Q1 in which a 0.4pt gross-margin cut and +5.7% personnel cost already took OP down 12.7%. The H1 NP shortfall against ¥5,000m will look larger still, probably 25–35%, because Q1's consolidated effective tax rate was 55% (¥1,492m on ¥2,702m). That headline (最終益) adds to the same release.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock has fallen after the last five prints, measured by me from Yahoo daily bars at kabutan's TDnet timestamps. FY2026.02 H1 (2025-10-02, 13:30): OP ¥6,833m against a ¥7,100m guide, a 3.8% miss with the FY guide kept, and the stock fell 4.18% that day. Q3 (2025-12-25, 13:30): −3.28%. FY (2026-04-02, 13:30): −2.17% that day, −4.22% to the next close. Q1 (2026-06-25, 15:30): gap −5.35% next open, −4.14% close to close. The prints before that were mixed or positive: H1 2024 −0.2%, Q1 2024 gap +8.6%.
evidence.why_not_priced: The street tracks the full year, not H1, and has cut it only to FY OP ¥13,500m. That still leaves H2 room to grow about 8–16%, and nothing published puts Q2 itself below last year. If the market had priced a Q2 decline, I would expect the 5-day underperformance to exceed the peer group's, and it does not: Heiwado fell about 4.9% while Hallows fell about 5.1%. I would also expect consensus to sit near ¥13,000m. When this name misses its own plan, kabutan's automatic '下振れ着地' headline has been sold every time in the last year, including a smaller 3.8% miss last October.
evidence.independence: The Q1 決算短信 is a separate document and supplies the starting point: Q1 OP ¥2,571m (−12.7%), 37% of the H1 plan, and a 55% tax rate (https://www.nikkei.com/markets/ir/irftp/data/tdnr/tdnetg3/20260625/fzrtmk/140120260623577308.pdf). The Q1 営業概況 supplies the 0.4pt gross-margin fall and the +5.7% personnel cost (https://www.heiwado.jp/assets/img/pages/ir/result/summary/2027/q1_gaikyo.pdf). One read cuts the other way: peer ハローズ reported a Q2 ordinary profit recovery of +5.7% on 2026-09-25 after a weak Q1 and fell only about 1% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2742&b=k202609250009). That is why the range runs to +1.0.

evidence.text: Q1 (2026-05-21 to 08-20) existing-store sales ran 97.5% / 100.3% / 100.7% (about 99.5%) against the 102.9% H1 premise behind the +14.9% H1 OP guide. With all-store sales at about 109% plus a roughly 2pt Spot M&A contribution, Q1 sales come to about 154-155bn, against about 158.6bn implied by the plan. On a mostly fixed SG&A base that puts OP at about 7.0-7.4bn (flat to -4% YoY) and ordinary at about 6.8-7.1bn: around 46-48% of the H1 ordinary plan, against the 62.6% five-year average kabutan prints mechanically.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Close-to-next-open on the actual print dates: Q1 FY5/26 (2025-10-02) gapped -5.5%. That print had OP -1% YoY, about 0.5bn below consensus, and a progress rate in line with the 5-year average (kabutan k202510020008; Fisco via kabutan n202510030563). Q1 FY5/25 (2024-10-03) gapped +3.66% on strong growth. Other prints: +0.34, -2.08, +1.91, +19.1 (special dividend and buyback), +1.86, +5.69 (aggressive FY27 guide). Median absolute about 2.8%.
evidence.why_not_priced: Partly priced, which is why it is small. The monthly numbers are public, the stock is -10.7% over 20 sessions against peers -4 to -7%, and IFIS consensus FY ordinary (28.9bn) already sits below the company's 30.8bn. What is not priced: the IFIS Q1 ordinary consensus of 7,350m (+0.9% YoY) has not been marked to the sub-100 same-store run. If it had, the Q1 bar would be at or below last year's 7,284m. Nothing has been revised either, so the release will mechanically print a progress rate about 15pt below the 5-year average, and kabutan's headline generator will say so. Last year a print with a normal progress rate still gapped -5.5%.
